label: Pecorino stagionato in foglie di noce

about.text: A semi-hard sheep cheese from Montefollonico in the province of Siena, made from sheep brought from Sardinia. It is aged at least three months in terracotta jars with walnut leaves, and is listed as a traditional product (PAT).
